existing_population._comment: Real QU headcounts per year level, 2021-2022 (most recent available; data/raw/enrollment_real_data.json). Used as the default 'students already enrolled today' snapshot for the ongoing/steady-state cohort engine -- faculty can override any of these via the Data Override panel or by importing a real per-student roster.

baseline_metrics_reference.note: Program-level 'on-time graduation rate' baselines used to sanity-check simulation output; see data/assumptions.json for reasoning (assumed, calibrated against the university-wide 150%-of-duration cohort rates of 57-74%, Fall 2012-2016, data.gov.qa).
